item.title: Kanojo no Kankei
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Jinsei Tsuukoudome
  • 発売日: 2024-12-20
  • スコア: 6.82/10 (15 人評価)
  • 日本語名: カノジョノカンケイ
  • 英語名: Kanojo no Kankei

あらすじ

The main character, Fumito Aida, who works part-time at a family restaurant, meets a college student, Yuma Asahina, who has joined the restaurant as a junior employee.

Fumito is not used to socializing with girls, but he is gradually attracted to her bright, energetic, and friendly personality and begins to like her.

However, Yuma is a girl who is out of his league. He has been thinking of confessing his feelings to her, but has been unable to do so.

  • 日本語名: コロモガワリ
  • 英語名: Koromogawari

あらすじ

It was the end of the year.

As usual, the main character, Yasuto, who came to a doujinshi sale by himself, happened to meet a girl classmate, Rina Kadokura, at the cosplay space.

Although they both have otaku hobbies, they quickly hit it off because they didn’t have anyone close to them to talk to.

别名

  • (Egao no Riyuu) The Reason For Your Smile

あらすじ

April – a time of meetings. My dad’s job transfer has sent the two of us to a new town, and me specifically to a new school. A new place is a chance for a new start, so I’m going to try and get myself my ideal girlfriend! I might be getting my hopes up, here, but it’s good to dream big!

别名

  • Irodori

あらすじ

Makoto Hirata is a pessimist who struggles to connect with people. His best relationship is with his childhood playmate, Mizuki. One day, by chance, Makoto witnesses the school “playboy” Hasegawa having sex with a girl classmate. Discovering a kind of thrill in the act of watching, Makoto continues to spy on him.

あらすじ

Tatsuya Kinoshita quit going to school because of a bully.

He became a fragile shut-in (hikikomori) who might never get past the damage.

The only person that gave him a reason to keep living was Hinata, a girl he knew his knew his whole life,

and the only one who treated him like a true friend before and after the bullying.

While the heroine makes her choices freely she’s still the plaything of a man who has broken a better love. He doesn’t care about anything but sex with her. Heartbreak abounds.

别名

  • Next to You

あらすじ

Protagonist Kouichi and heroine Asahi were childhood friends.

Wherever they went they were together always, inseparable from each other’s side, sharing in the joys of youth. As they grew older, that friendship became love.

Life began to change in junior high school, though. Her male senpai slowly took her away with charm and guile.

item.title: Boku no Daiji na Ane wa Aitsu no Omocha
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Jinsei Tsuukoudome
  • 発売日: 2010-07-21
  • スコア: 5.46/10 (12 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 僕の大事な姉はあいつのオモチャ
  • 英語名: Boku no Daiji na Ane wa Aitsu no Omocha

别名

  • My beloved big sister is his toy

あらすじ

I have a precious sister. Ever since my mother died when I was young, she has always been a substitute for my mother. She has always been by my side, in place of my father, who is often away on business trips. She is always by my side, even in hard times - when I feel lonely, when I feel sad. Even when I feel happy. She is an irreplaceable and precious person. That’s why I thought she would always be by my side. Until I heard those words from Mayu’s mouth.
